ideas.pitch: A real-time 1v1 competitive coding platform built specifically for solo participants to practice 30-minute MCQ and rapid problem-solving formats like CodeClash.
ideas.title: CodeClash Duels Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: CodeClash is organized by HackKro on Unstop as a competitive coding and MCQ challenge, so targeting the exact user base of competitive programmers and students creates instant relevance for the organizers.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered tool that automatically parses data structures and core programming documentation to instantly generate high-difficulty multiple-choice questions for competitive coding trainers.
ideas.title: Algorize MCQ Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since the hackathon round consists entirely of 30 multiple-choice questions on core programming and data structures, this directly solves the bottleneck of creating reliable quiz questions for judges and event organizers.

ideas.pitch: An interactive logic-tracing visualizer designed to help beginners step through basic data structures and core programming snippet executions line by line.
ideas.title: DataStruct Visually
ideas.why_it_could_win: The hackathon specifically caters to both beginners and experienced developers focusing on Data Structures Basics, making educational tools with clear usability highly appealing to judges.

ideas.pitch: A gamified rapid-fire aptitude and logical reasoning trainer optimized for mobile web browsers to help students drill under 30-minute time constraints.
ideas.title: AptitudeArena
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aptitude and logical reasoning form a core evaluation component of the CodeClash 1.0 syllabus, making a targeted prep tool extremely practical for participants.

ideas.pitch: A performance benchmarking dashboard that ingests past competitive coding quiz results and provides personalized weak-spot analysis for core programming and data structures.
ideas.title: CodeClash Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the organizers' goal of boosting technical growth and measuring problem-solving skills among college students across all streams.
